title: Albert Einstein House: National Register of Historic Places, National Historic Landmark photographs (76002297)
notes: NPGallery copy of the photograph sheet filed with the NHL nomination (EIN-S-0091 is the text). The url serves a 2-page PDF (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 473,824 bytes); page 1 is one photograph captioned 'Albert Einstein Home, Princeton, New Jersey' and 'NPS Photo 1975' (embedded scan 2226 x 1797 px, 225 ppi). fetch_snapshot.py has no PDF reader, so the snapshot is the PDF's own text layer extracted with pdftotext (poppler, no layout option), unedited (it carries OCR noise around the caption), saved with --method manual. NPGallery's asset page (https://npgallery.nps.gov/AssetDetail/NRIS/76002297) shows only a site-wide copyright notice, no item-level rights statement.

title: U. S. Post Office and Courthouse, Mercer County, New Jersey: National Register of Historic Places Registration Form (12000309)
notes: NPGallery copy of the NRHP registration form for the U.S. Post Office and Courthouse, 402 East State Street, Trenton (completed 1932; current name Clarkson S. Fisher U.S. Courthouse). 59-page PDF (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 7,508,474 bytes); pages 49-57 carry photographs #20-#28 of the photo log (2005/2009, Carson Anderson and Caleb Harms for ICF Jones & Stokes, grayscale scans about 1630 x 1257 px); page 55 is photo #26 'Third floor, ceremonial courtroom.' Snapshot: the PDF's text layer by pdftotext (poppler, no layout option), unedited, --method manual. Same form at NARA: NAID 135815057 (12000309.pdf, 138,856,560 bytes, use restriction 'Restricted - Possibly', copyright note).

title: U. S. Post Office and Courthouse: Third floor, ceremonial courtroom
credit: Carson Anderson and Caleb Harms for ICF Jones & Stokes; National Register of Historic Places registration form 12000309, NPGallery, National Park Service.
notes: Rooms run 2026-10-20 (chapter 6, citizenship). Photo #26 of the registration form (page 55 of the PDF), 2005 or 2009, grayscale scan about 1630 x 1257 px; the form's section 7 describes Courtroom 1 ('Ceremonial Courtroom') in detail (oak wainscot, judge's dais, ceiling), which with the photo is enough to model the room. The form says courtrooms 1, 2 and 3 are original to the 1932 building and the floors hold offices of the U.S. District Court. No source on file says the 1940 ceremony (EIN-F-0051) took place in this building or this room: a reconstruction must be labelled as the Trenton federal courthouse of the U.S. District Court, never as 'the room where'. Rights: no item-level statement; reference only.
